name: restaurant_group
archetype: Multi-location local restaurant group and hospitality brand
market: Local diners, event bookers, food media, tourists, delivery customers
density: Food photography-forward with generous whitespace. Menu sections clean and readable. Multiple restaurant locations shown in clean cards. Reservation CTA prominent. Chef story important. Award badges displayed.
nav_style: Elegant minimal nav with wordmark. Restaurants, Menu, Reservations, Events, About, Gift Cards. Reserve Now CTA in a rich terracotta or deep plum. Possibly a 'Today's Hours' indicator.
commercial_model: Multi-location restaurant group. Revenue from in-person dining, private events, catering, gift cards. Delivery through third-party partners. No subscription model. Michelin recognition mentioned if applicable.
color_palette: Deep plum (#4A1040) as primary — sophisticated dinner table aesthetic. Cream (#FDF8F0) for warm page backgrounds. Gold (#B8892F) for premium accents, menu price text, and thin divider lines (1px gold lines between menu sections). Charcoal (#3D3D3D) for body text. Warm amber lighting treatment: images use CSS overlay of rgba(255,248,225,0.15) to evoke candlelight warmth. Section dividers: 1px solid #B8892F gold. Box shadows use warm tones: 0 4px 24px rgba(74,16,64,0.12).
typography: Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display for restaurant names and menu headings — aristocratic, food-appropriate. Lato for body and menu item descriptions. Menu prices in tabular figures. Chef name in italic. Wine list in small refined type.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Full-bleed food hero image. Group tagline. Restaurant locations grid with card for each location: photo, name, cuisine type, neighborhood, hours, Reserve button. Awards strip. Press quote section. Private events CTA.

pages.title: Our Restaurants
pages.description: Restaurant directory. Each restaurant: full-width photo, name, cuisine description, neighborhood, hours, chef name, signature dishes callout, and Reserve/Order links. Ambience photos gallery.

pages.title: Menu
pages.description: Restaurant selector then menu sections: Starters, Mains, Sides, Desserts, Drinks. Each dish: name, description, price, dietary icons (V, GF, VG, DF). Seasonal specials flagged. Wine pairing suggestions.

pages.title: Reservations
pages.description: Reservation form: restaurant selector, date picker, time selector, party size, special requests. OpenTable or Resy embed. Private dining inquiry form for larger groups. Cancellation policy.

pages.title: Events & Private Dining
pages.description: Private events program. Room capacity and layout options. Sample menus for events. Photo gallery of past events. Inquiry form. Chef's table experiences. Seasonal tasting menu events calendar.
